title: AI QA Execution Journal — Prompt Record
description: One entry in platform/tasks/<task-name>/journal/prompts.json → prompts[]. Stored once per (prompt_id, prompt_version) per task, so the HTML journal can show the exact prompt text for every event without repeating it in each event.

sha256.description: Hash of the prompt file at capture time.

content.description: Verbatim prompt file content (template form, before variable substitution). Variables used per run are stored in the event's prompt_variables.
